blocks.heading: BSc Subject Opens Which Exam
rows: UPSC Indian Forest Service (notice 06/2026)

A bachelor's degree with at least one of: Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Science, Botany, Chemistry, Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Zoology. Or a degree in Agriculture, Forestry or Engineering.

Botany and Zoology are named. Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Life Science, Environmental Science, Nursing and Pharmacy are not. Check that your degree carries Botany or Zoology as a subject.
Official
APPSC Forest Range Officer (notification 16/2026)
Agriculture, Botany, Chemistry, Computer Science, several engineering branches, Environmental Science, Forestry, Geology, Horticulture, Maths, Physics, Statistics, Veterinary Science, Zoology.
Environmental Science is named here, so the same degree can pass a state forest exam and miss the central one. Four posts are reported for this notification.
Secondary
Bihar BPSSC Forest Range Officer 2026
Botany, Chemistry, Maths, Physics, Zoology, Agriculture, Engineering, Forestry.
A different state, a shorter list. Read your own state notice each cycle.
Secondary
CSIR-UGC NET (JRF)
A master's degree at 55 percent (50 percent reserved), or a four-year bachelor's at 75 percent. Age up to 30 with relaxations.
Life-science majors all qualify. The four-year BSc route gives JRF and PhD entry but not assistant professor.
Official
IIT JAM (Biotechnology and Biological Sciences)
Rules differ by IIT. Reports show M.Sc Biotechnology at IIT Bombay open to any subject, and Biological Sciences at IIT Delhi open to any STEM bachelor's.
One of the widest doors. A BSc in any life-science subject usually works. Confirm in the JAM 2027 brochure.
Secondary
Entrance Exam Life Sciences (XL) and Biotechnology (BT)
A bachelor's degree in life sciences, biology, biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry and related fields, per a 2023 explainer. Final-year students can apply.
Registration for Entrance Exam 2027 closes 5 October 2026 (12 October with late fee). Check the brochure for your degree name.

blocks.heading: Myth Against the Rule
rows: "Biology after 12th means medicine."

NEET-linked seats are about 2.23 lakh against about 20 lakh test-takers, or 111 per 1,000. The other biology doors add up to many more seats, though most are in nursing and pharmacy, not in selective programmes.
"Any biology BSc qualifies for forest service."
The UPSC notice names Botany and Zoology and skips Biotechnology, Microbiology and Environmental Science. A state exam may name Environmental Science. Check each notice.
"A BSc in Zoology or Botany is worthless."
Those are the two life-science subjects named on the central forest exam, and BSc life-science degrees feed JAM, Entrance Exam and NET. The weak spot is pay without a second skill, not eligibility.
"Every biology course needs NEET."
Only the NEET-linked seats do. ICAR seats use CUET, IISER uses IAT, forensic science at NFSU uses CUET, and BPT and BOT use Class 12 marks for 2026-27.
"A PhD is the natural next step after a life-science BSc."
In June 2024, 1.2 percent of NET test-takers reached the top category, and a fellowship is training, not a job. Compare it with an industry role honestly.
"Ranking pages give you salary figures."
Of eight ranking pages we read, six printed salary bands and none sourced more than two of its figures. Two printed no salary at all. Sourced pay with sample sizes is in the pay section above.
